searchBoundary: Searched for Aurora Figure 7 cohort identifiers, RO-Crate cohort membership, battery endpoint inspection cadence, condition-based reference-performance testing, grid-phase sensitivity, and pair-powered lifetime validation. Discovery searches were followed to publisher, repository, institutional, or specification sources before use.

sources.result: The paper reports a Figure 7 batch of 36 LFP/graphite cells, states that Aurora can assemble up to 36 coin cells per batch, and links the Zenodo dataset.
sources.limit: The article text does not provide a machine-readable mapping from the 36 plotted curves to archive cell IDs.

sources.result: The official archive provides 199 cell directories with per-cell metadata and BDF CSV and Parquet payloads plus an RO-Crate document.
sources.limit: The RO-Crate inventories files but does not label Figure 7 membership or a 36-cell LFP cohort.

sources.result: The recommendation defines an RO-Crate metadata document that may describe some or all files and contextual provenance.
sources.limit: Omission of cohort relations is therefore not by itself a conformance failure; it is a failure of fitness for this outcome-blind selection task.

sources.result: A capacity-loss-driven method scheduled RPTs in 1% loss steps and produced 44% more aging cycles over the first 100 days than a fixed 200-cycle interval while delivering a deterministic number of RPTs.
sources.limit: Its data are available on request, and it does not establish a pair-power or independent lifetime-transport rule.

sources.result: The study uses the same 48-cell RWTH source with capacity checks every 160 cycles and reports changepoint features for SOH estimation.
sources.limit: It identifies feature utility but calls for validation under varied operating conditions and LFP chemistry; it does not repair the four-cell-block pair ceiling.

sources.result: Rate-adaptive transformation and mechanism-informed residual learning enable rapid diagnostics and early lifetime prediction across unseen aging conditions using public datasets.
sources.limit: Diagnostic transport remains distinct from a prospectively sealed cell-level EOL rank test.

combinationAssessment.proposedCombination: Separate a sparse feature register from a dense endpoint register, size one same-condition block by an exact non-tied-pair distribution, exhaustively vary grid phase and lifetime-spread compression, and require an outcome-blind paper-to-file manifest before opening a target.
combinationAssessment.overlap: Condition-based RPTs, early-life capacity features, rank metrics, and RO-Crate provenance each have prior art.
combinationAssessment.difference: No reviewed source combined the block-combinatorial ceiling, exact worst-phase pair-power calculation, two-register measurement separation, and cohort-lineage gate into one target-opening rule.
combinationAssessment.noveltyBoundary: The combination is recorded as a testable project proposal, not claimed as literature-first or patent-new. A systematic review and patent search would be required before any novelty claim.
